summary: Frontend-only test of NivXRay Feb-2026 FIX A (binary payload banner) & FIX B (save-case 60s timeout). Login OK. FIX B verified end-to-end (Save Case succeeded in <1s, status='CASE SAVED', pickTimeout /cases/save = 60_000 confirmed in api.js). FIX A detector logic verified via in-browser unit test mirror (triggers on random 300B binary → entropy 7.26, printable 34%; correctly returns null on plain text and on <64B input). Regression PASSES: powershell-encodedcommand payload decodes to readable 'start-process notepad', binary-payload-banner does NOT appear. CLEAR button correctly wipes input, output and banners. CAVEAT: could not observe the banner rendered in the actual UI because NivXRay's decode pipeline serializes decoded binary bytes to base64 before delivering them to OutputView's `output` prop — a pure base64 string has max Shannon entropy ~6.0, which cannot exceed the detector's >6.5 threshold. All AUTO INVESTIGATE outputs tested (random 256B blob, random 512B blob, hex-decoded random 200B) came back as base64 strings with printable=100%, entropy 5.85-5.94, so the banner never fires through normal flows. The detector code itself is correct and wired properly (buttons, testids, useEffect reset, placeholder update all present in OutputView.jsx); it will fire IF/WHEN raw non-printable bytes reach the output prop.

integration_issues.flow: FIX A binary-payload-banner surfacing in real decode flows
integration_issues.issue: Banner detector requires entropy > 6.5 AND printable < 50%, but OutputView receives `output` as a base64 string in every tested binary decode path (AUTO INVESTIGATE with random-bytes-b64, hex-decoded random). Base64's max entropy ceiling ~6.0 means the >6.5 threshold is unreachable via current pipeline. Analyst-facing outcome: the fix's targeted scenario (MSFvenom XOR-decoded shellcode) will likely still not trigger the banner because those bytes are also re-base64ed before reaching OutputView. Consider (a) passing raw-bytes-as-latin1 to OutputView so entropy stays >7, or (b) lowering the entropy threshold to ~5.5 with a length gate, or (c) computing entropy on pre-encoding bytes upstream and passing a boolean flag.

action_items: Confirm whether the OutputView `output` prop actually receives raw non-printable bytes in the intended shellcode/MSFvenom scenarios. If it's always base64, the entropy>6.5 threshold will never fire and the fix won't reach analysts. See integration_issues above for suggested mitigations.
OPTIONAL: expose a dev/test hook (e.g. window.__nvxSetOutput) so QA can drive OutputView with synthetic raw binary to unit-test the banner in headless CI.
critical_code_review_comments: OutputView.jsx detectBinaryPayload() is well-scoped, correctly O(n) with 4096-char sample cap. Threshold logic (entropy>6.5 && printable<0.5 && len>=64) is mathematically sound but may not be reachable in practice — see integration_issues note.
api.js pickTimeout() correctly routes /cases/save to 60_000ms. Regex order is fine (checked before the generic fallback).
showRawBinary useEffect reset on `output` change is correct and prevents leftover reveal-state across decodes.
Banner is correctly suppressed when shellcode-banner or terminal-tail already claims the render (memo dependency chain is clean).
Placeholder text swap is a nice UX touch.
